native_actions: Open an untouched copy of original baseline.weftforge, revision1 allocator11. Opening must not be treated as restoring old Undo history.
Select Existing baseline, commit Width .11 m by Return: revision2. Commit Width .12 m by Return: revision3. Undo once: revision4 Width .11, with both Undo and Redo available.
Save preimport.weftforge at revision4 before entering pending Width .125. Capture exact native state, both history directions and dirty state. Enter pending .125 without Return or ordinary blur.
Open Import DXF using the toolbar and native chooser. Cancel chooser; pending draft, revision4, Undo/Redo and dirty state must persist. Reopen chooser and select original-editable-patterns.dxf.

Capture review BEFORE Import: count2, fixed millimetre scale .001m/unit, WCS X/Y origin/layout retained, literal layer-name convention, omitted names/native IDs/sewing/materials/grain/placement/drape/internal/print scope. Background authoring must be disabled.

Cancel review and reopen through command search; pending .125, revision4, dirty state and both history directions must still persist. Escape review must also preserve them. Reopen and select the same original source.
Accept Import once: revision5, 3 pieces, baseline width .125, imported source geometry, allocator29. Save imported.weftforge.
Undo once: revision6, one old rectangle width .11, allocator29; save undo_import.weftforge. Undo once again: revision7, width .1, allocator29; save undo_prior.weftforge.
Redo once: revision8 width .11; save redo_prior.weftforge. Redo once: revision9, imported pieces plus width .125 with identical IDs; save redo_import.weftforge.
Select WF_PIECE_17 second boundary cubic; change ONLY P1 U from -.01 to 0.0 m with Return: revision10. Save edited.weftforge.

Attempt native import of late-gap.dxf; no new pieces/history/revision or material change. Save rejected.weftforge without editing. Also review invalid-source rejection with a pending draft separately; retained draft may later commit on ordinary blur, so do not confuse that commit with failed import.

Export final direct SVG and DXF. Quit the native process, relaunch exact bound app, reopen edited.weftforge, resave as reopened.weftforge, and export direct final SVG/DXF. Record process identities and actual chooser/save steps. Reopened document must equal edited10 exactly.
Grade nine checkpoints and final export files with evaluate.py, then review raw native trace independently. No file-only native acceptance claim.
headless_success_grading: All original authoring exact, old width.1, exactly two new named pieces, no Y inversion/origin/arrangement change, defaults and fresh IDs/allocator29.
Summary count2, metres_per_user_unit .001, preserved WCS X/Y origin/layout convention and explicit construction-only scope. Adapter schema and strict shared-command variant agree.

Run in-place import on valid baseline primary with a deliberately byte-distinct valid existing recovery. Success recovery equals exact pre-save primary bytes. No recovery expectation is inferred from suffix alone.
